questions.q: What does this lesson say your Trailblazer profile actually tracks?
options: Every badge, point, and trail completed, verified automatically against your actual org
Only self-reported claims you type in manually
Nothing — Trailblazer profiles are purely decorative
Only your billing history
questions.explain: Badges, points, and trails are tracked automatically as Trailhead verifies the actual hands-on work done in your connected org.

questions.q: What is the core difference this lesson draws between a Trailhead module and a superbadge?
options: A module gives step-by-step instructions with an auto-verified challenge; a superbadge gives a real scenario with no step-by-step instructions
A module costs money while a superbadge is always free
A superbadge only exists in Classic, never in Lightning Experience
There is no real difference between the two
questions.explain: Modules walk you through steps with an automatically verified challenge, while superbadges present a scenario you must solve without step-by-step guidance.

questions.q: What does this lesson say many Trailhead modules and projects deploy directly into your org?
options: Entire working sample apps with real code and data, like LWC Recipes
A virus scanner
A completely separate Trailhead account
Nothing is ever deployed into the org by a module
questions.explain: Many modules and projects deploy genuine working sample apps, complete with real code and data, directly into the learner's org.

questions.q: How does this lesson say LTV's own hands-on labs are built?
options: The same way Trailhead's content is: real records, created and verified inside your actual org, not multiple-choice questions
Entirely as multiple-choice quizzes with no hands-on component
Using a completely separate, unrelated platform from Salesforce
Only as video lectures with no practice component
questions.explain: LTV's labs deliberately follow the same pattern as Trailhead's hands-on challenges: real work verified inside a real org.

questions.q: Per this lesson, why can a recruiter or hiring manager trust a Trailblazer profile's badge count?
options: Because badges are earned through verified hands-on work, not self-reported claims
Because anyone can edit their own badge count directly
Because badge counts are randomly generated
Trailblazer profiles cannot be viewed by anyone outside Salesforce
questions.explain: Because Trailhead verifies the actual work against the learner's org, the resulting badge count is a genuine, checkable credential rather than a self-reported claim.
